page_title: SEV 1-2 ATM | Sevilla v Atletico Madrid 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) gets booked.
90+6' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Kike Salas (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.

90+3' 1 - 2 Goal! Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Orjan Nyland had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:2.
90+1' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Substitution. Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) in, Lucien Agoume out.
89' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Orjan Nyland stops the ball from going inside right post.
87' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom left corner only for Jan Oblak to dive and make a save.
85' The whistle blows and Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) is booked for an infringement.
85' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid).
80' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle and it's Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
80' A dangerous towering header by Loic Bade (Sevilla) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
79' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
78' Substitution. Thomas Lemar (Atl. Madrid) has come on for Conor Gallagher.
78' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
77' Great save! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Orjan Nyland.
77' The attendance is 34505.
77' A pass into the penalty area from Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by the defence.
75' Atl. Madrid fail to score from a corner as Orjan Nyland (Sevilla) leaps to collect the ball.
75' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Atl. Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
71' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
69' Substitution. Isaac Romero (Sevilla) replaces Chidera Ejuke.
69' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Albert Sambi Lokonga will be replaced by Saul Niguez (Sevilla).
68' Giuliano Simeone comes off the pitch to be replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
67' Atl. Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' Kike Salas (Sevilla) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Jan Oblak sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
57' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) gets a yellow card.
56' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) replaces Antoine Griezmann.
55' It is time for a substitution. Koke (Atl. Madrid) is on for Cesar Azpilicueta.
54' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
51' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Cesar Soto Grado and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
50' Atl. Madrid get a corner.

50' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Orjan Nyland pulls off a brilliant save. Atl. Madrid will take a corner kick.
48' Kike Salas (Sevilla) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
46' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta makes a half-time substitution. Nemanja Gudelj comes on in place of Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla).
46' Half-time substitution. Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) will not participate anymore and Javi Galan is coming on.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
45+1' A corner kick by Sevilla is thwarted by the well prepared Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid).
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
39' A player from Sevilla commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
39' Sevilla force their opponents to concede a corner.
38' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. Corner kick. Sevilla will have an opportunity.
33' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
30' Akor Adams (Sevilla) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
25' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Orjan Nyland no chance!
24' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is going to take the penalty!
23' Loic Bade (Sevilla) trips an opposition player and Cesar Soto Grado signals a foul. That is a penalty kick for Atl. Madrid.
23' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
22' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
21' Dangerous play by Akor Adams (Sevilla). Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Atl. Madrid.
20' Half-chance! Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) plays a pass into the box, but Jan Oblak reacts well to snuff out the attack.

18' What a chance that is! Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
17' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
15' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Orjan Nyland intercepts the ball.
13' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) but poses no threat.
11' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta is forced to make a change. Ruben Vargas is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla).
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the right post. It's 1:0.
7' Atl. Madrid are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' The corner from Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is cleared away by the defence.
3' Sevilla work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
2' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
2' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Sevilla.
